items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Well, this is Anderson Lacy's letter wrote to Driggs and told him that he was living in Houston.

ctx.x: It was out of Little Town of Hines. But all these fellas, they come from these small towns, and they get prominently known in the show business. They ask him where he from, they say, well, he's there. It gives them maybe a little more security saving from that. They say in Little Town, Rainy, Louisiana, or Cancone, Louisiana, or something like that. Because nobody would know where these towns would be. But right away he said, well, this guy has to be there.

Well, this is Anderson Lacy's letter wrote to Driggs and told him that he was living in Houston. He's age 72 or 73. And Driggs wrote to you on February 9, 1971. So I don't know if he's living in the other one.
Well, I don't think he is. Frank Briggs wanted a lot of international Southwest jazz musicians. And our friends to him as much as I possibly can. Now, let's see.
